title: A Target-Aware Analysis of Data Augmentation for Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing F1 performance of hate speech detection models on gender-specific texts (e.g., targeting women and trans people) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus and HateCheck test suite before and after target-aware data augmentation.

Comparing F1 performance of hate speech detection models on race-specific texts (e.g., targeting Black people) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus and HateCheck test suite before and after target-aware data augmentation.

Comparing F1 performance of hate speech detection models on origin-specific texts (e.g., targeting immigrants) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus and HateCheck test suite before and after target-aware data augmentation.

Comparing F1 performance of hate speech detection models on sexuality-specific texts (e.g., targeting gay people) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus and HateCheck test suite before and after target-aware data augmentation.

Comparing F1 performance of hate speech detection models on religion-specific texts (e.g., targeting Muslims) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus and HateCheck test suite before and after target-aware data augmentation.

Comparing F1 performance of hate speech detection models on disability-specific texts (e.g., targeting disabled people) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus and HateCheck test suite before and after target-aware data augmentation.
Comparing F1 performance of hate speech detection models on age-specific texts from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus before and after target-aware data augmentation.
